prompt: Make the dataset builder configurable for repeated experiments without source edits. Keep the existing preprocessing implementation as the source of truth, add a checked-in tb-detection.toml example plus config init/show/validate commands, and support CLI overrides for the seed, input/output directories, target image size, split ratios, and logging level. Reject invalid cross-field values before processing, test precedence and errors, and document the exact commands in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.
assertions: tb-detection.toml and config init/show/validate commands expose the requested dataset settings.
The implementation maps configuration into the existing typed dataset configuration rather than maintaining duplicate preprocessing constants.
The effective precedence is deterministic and CLI overrides take priority over config-file values.
Invalid split ratios, dimensions, or other cross-field values fail during validation before processing begins with an actionable error.
Tests cover precedence and invalid configuration, and both command documents describe the same contract.
